product_one_liner.value: SiteVue AI provides AI-powered cameras and video analytics for industrial operations leaders to monitor productivity, quality and workplace safety.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes cameras paired with video analytics for operations leaders; the investor’s description explicitly identifies productivity, quality and safety as the platform’s scope.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage has no pricing link, the pricing endpoints did not yield a page, and the product FAQ directs visitors to request a quote rather than providing a public plans page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: SiteVue’s homepage publishes customer testimonials attributed to Foster Farms and XOS Trucks, describing their use of the product. | named_customers.0: Foster Farms’ plant manager describes using SiteVue to monitor its production lines. | named_customers.1: An XOS Trucks executive provides a SiteVue customer testimonial about identifying productivity improvements.

employee_band.notes: The company release reports 37 employees and the company profile reports 40; both counts fall within 21–50.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s release explicitly calls Nashville, Tennessee its headquarters. Its company profile lists Franklin, so the explicit headquarters statement is preferred with reduced confidence. | hq_country: The company profile explicitly identifies its country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The company’s press release explicitly states that SiteVue AI was founded in August 2025.

eng_blog.notes: No blog was located. The homepage links to Press rather than a blog, and the Press page is marked Coming Soon. Without a blog index, the engineering-blog test cannot be applied.

public_docs.notes: The inspected homepage navigation and footer provide company and social links but no documentation, help-center or developer-portal link, satisfying the specified negative criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable company job board lists zero open roles, including no qualifying AI, ML or data-science opening.

model_provider.value: SiteVue AI’s own custom-trained AI models.
model_provider.notes: SiteVue is described as training its own AI models, and its release says custom-trained models analyze camera footage. This identifies in-house models without asserting an undisclosed architecture or third-party provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The security endpoint returned a 404 and the privacy endpoint returned a redirect rather than substantive legal content. No qualifying certification source was found, so neither a certification claim nor an empty-list negative is established.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest recorded financing is explicitly labeled Seed Funding. | funding_date: The funding profile identifies August 6, 2026 as the latest round, matching the company announcement’s date; the requested month is 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile reports $7,500,000 in seed funding and identifies August 6, 2026 as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The $7.5 million seed financing was announced in August 2026, within the eighteen-month lookback.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable company job board lists zero open roles, including no SDR, BDR or account-executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The dated product-launch item reports the launch of SiteVue’s AI-powered manufacturing cameras on August 6, 2026, within the six-month lookback.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Patrick Baird’s VP role is identifiable, but no appointment or departure date was provided. The available team listing was incomplete, preventing either a verified change or a fully checked negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No readable SiteVue job descriptions, product documentation or integrations page was located from which to establish a CRM or sales-and-marketing system. Unknown is retained rather than an unsupported empty list.
